newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates flat, forint down vs dlr, basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates flat, forint down vs dlr, basket.

text.p: 0650 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates were practically unchanged on Monday, on the last day of the banks' two-week reserve period.
* Overnight rates traded between 18.00 and 18.25 percent with most of the deals struck at 18.00 percent, the level where the rates finished on Friday.
* The forint was expected to open weaker against the dollar and some 10 pips below the central bank's resistance level (bid) due to end-of month currency buying started on Friday.
* The Hungarian unit was seen opening at around 186.90/95 against the dollar compared with Friday's close of 185.95/186.00.
